title: The FREE GitHub skill that deletes every AI tell.
description:
That list wasn't written for writers.

It was written by AI hunters.

Wikipedia volunteers hunted AI articles for years.

They tagged over five hundred of them.

Then wrote down every tell.

That's a detection manual.

Humanizer just runs it backwards.

You're not learning to write better.

You're holding the grader's rubric.

And it's never one em dash.

Humans use those too.

It's the stacking that busts you.

Tell after tell, same rhythm.

Like leaving fingerprints you can't see.

This wipes them before you post.

Run it on your landing pages.

Your proposals. Your posts.

Readers never name the tell.

They just quietly stop trusting you.

Run it before you publish.

#humanizer #github #wikipedia #aislop #writing
